The '''Seymarti system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It has a one [[White dwarf/Legends|white star]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seymarti V]].<ref name="EAOC" />
